# Kyoto Spring Trip Plan for 2 Adults

A relaxed 4-day Kyoto itinerary for **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13** with temples, food markets, and one easy day trip. I’ve assumed a **mid-range hotel near Kyoto Station or Shijo/Kawaramachi Station** and priced local transport and meals for **2 adults**.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan

### Day 1: Arrival, Kyoto Station Area, and Gion Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, settle near Kyoto Station, and keep the first day light.
- Afternoon: Kyoto Station area walk, Kyoto Tower area, and a slow start at Nishiki Market for snacks and lunch.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Kyoto Station area walk, Kyoto Tower area, and a slow start at Nishiki Market for snacks and lunch, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Gion stroll, Yasaka Shrine area, and an early dinner nearby.
- Local transport: **$12–$20**
- Meals: **$70–$110**
- Overnight: Kyoto Station or Shijo area

### Day 2: Eastern Kyoto Temples and Scenic Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, and a relaxed temple-to-street walk.
- Afternoon: Kodai-ji, Yasaka Pagoda area, and a cafe break instead of packing in more sights.
- Evening: Return to central Kyoto for dinner and an optional short river walk.
- Local transport: **$10–$18**
- Meals: **$75–$120**
- Overnight: Kyoto Station or Shijo area

### Day 3: Arashiyama Day Trip
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- Morning: Head to Arashiyama early, then Bamboo Grove and Tenryu-ji.
- Afternoon: Monkey Park or a slow riverside lunch, plus Togetsukyo Bridge and the district streets.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/ea/Iwatayama_Monkey_Kyoto.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Monkey Park or a slow riverside lunch, plus Togetsukyo Bridge and the district streets, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Back to Kyoto for a calm dinner near the hotel.
- Local transport: **$16–$28**
- Meals: **$80–$130**
- Overnight: Kyoto Station or Shijo area

### Day 4: Northern Temples, Market Time, and Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Kinkaku-ji or a quieter temple option depending on energy.
- Afternoon: Last food-market stop, souvenir shopping, and hotel pickup.
- Evening: Depart or enjoy one final easy dinner before leaving.
- Local transport: **$12–$22**
- Meals: **$65–$110**
- Overnight: Not needed unless your flight is next day

## Budget Estimate for 2 Adults

| Category | Estimated Total | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel, 3 nights | **$720–$1,050** | Mid-range near Kyoto Station / Shijo |
| Local transport | **$50–$88** | Subway, bus, JR, and one day trip |
| Meals | **$290–$470** | Mix of markets, casual lunches, and sit-down dinners |
| Entry fees | **$40–$90** | Temples, gardens, and optional paid sites |
| Total | **$1,100–$1,698** | Fits your **$1,900** cap with buffer |

## Best Hotel Area and Pace Fit

- **Best area:** Kyoto Station if you want easiest arrival/departure and day-trip access.
- **Best backup area:** Shijo/Kawaramachi if you want more dining and evening walkability.
- **Pace:** This plan keeps each day to **2–3 main stops max**, with built-in breaks.
- **Day trip choice:** **Arashiyama** is the best fit for a relaxed single day trip without overloading transit.
